args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) per FIN-212

The function docstring already specified banker's rounding per FIN-212,
but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch the rounding mode to
ROUND_HALF_EVEN so 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66 as required.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but FIN-212 requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) — the docstring already specified it. This caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`.

## Change
- Switch the rounding mode in `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
- Now `Decimal("2.675") -> Decimal("2.68")` and `Decimal("2.665") -> Decimal("2.66")`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` @ `08d3cd59` passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.

Note: a run of `tests/test_ledger.py::test_totals` failed on main @ `0c0ffee000` as flaky — unrelated to this change.
